'''Micah Peavy''' (born July 16, 2001) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball|TCU Horned Frogs]], the [[Texas Tech Red Raiders men's basketball|Texas Tech Red Raiders]] and the [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown Hoyas]].

==Early life and high school==
Peavy attended [[Duncanville High School]] in [[Duncanville, Texas]]. As a senior he averaged 19 points and 7.5 rebounds per game and was named the TABC Class 6A player of the year.<ref name="transfer">{{cite web |last1=Davison |first1=Drew |title=This basketball transfer from Texas Tech has won everywhere. He expects the same at TCU |url=https://www.star-telegram.com/sports/college/big-12/texas-christian-university/article250670689.html |website=Fort Worth Star-Telegram |access-date=March 4, 2025}}</ref> Coming out of high school, Peavy was rated as the 32nd overall player in the class of 2020 and committed to play [[college basketball]] for the [[Texas Tech Red Raiders men's basketball|Texas Tech Red Raiders]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Borzello |first1=Jeff |title=Top-35 prospect Micah Peavy commits to Texas Tech |url=https://www.espn.com/college-sports/recruiting/basketball/mens/story/_/id/28005383/top-35-prospect-micah-peavy-commits-texas-tech |website=ESPN |access-date=March 4, 2025}}</ref>

==College career==
=== Texas Tech ===
As a freshman in 2020–21, Peavy made 25 starts where he averaged 5.7 points per game for Texas Tech.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Griffith |first1=Katherine |title=Ex-Texas Tech guard Micah Peavy announces transfer to TCU |url=https://www.dallasnews.com/sports/tcu-horned-frogs/2021/04/14/frogs-land-texas-tech-transfer-micah-peavy/ |website=Dallas News |access-date=March 4, 2025}}</ref> After the season, he entered his name into the [[NCAA transfer portal]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Reports: Texas Tech guard Micah Peavy to enter transfer portal |url=https://www.dallasnews.com/sports/texas-tech-red-raiders/2021/04/02/reports-texas-tech-guard-micah-peavy-to-enter-transfer-portal/ |website=Dallas News |access-date=March 4, 2025}}</ref>

=== TCU ===
Peavy transferred to play for the [[TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball|TCU Horned Frogs]].<ref name=transfer/> In 2021–22, he appeared in 34 games with nine starts, where he averaged 6.1 points, 4.0 rebounds, 1.2 assists, and 0.6 steals per game.<ref name="SR">{{cite web |title=Micah Peavy College Stats |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/micah-peavy-1.html |website=Sports Reference |access-date=March 4, 2025}}</ref> In 2022–23, Peavy played in 30 games with eight starts and averaged 7.0 points, 3.1 rebounds, 1.2 assists, and 1.0 steal per game.<ref name=SR/> In 2023–24, he averaged 10.9 points, 4.9 rebounds, and 2.6 assists per game.<ref name="GTown">{{cite web |last1=Tipton |first1=Joe |title=TCU transfer guard Micah Peavy commits to Georgetown |url=https://www.on3.com/college/georgetown-hoyas/news/tcu-transfer-guard-micah-peavy-commits-to-georgetown/ |website=On3.com |access-date=March 4, 2025}}</ref> After the season, Peavy once again entered his name into the NCAA transfer portal.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Grubbs |first1=Grant |title=Report: TCU guard Micah Peavy plans to enter NBA Draft, NCAA Transfer Portal |url=https://www.on3.com/transfer-portal/news/report-tcu-guard-micah-peavy-plans-to-enter-nba-draft-ncaa-transfer-portal/ |website=On3.com |access-date=March 4, 2025}}</ref>

=== Georgetown ===
